An '''orchard loaf''' is baked from late fruit and hard flour.

== What you need ==
* 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] hard flour
* 2 late fruit, mashed

== Procedure ==
# Work the flour and the fruit into a dough.
# Bake it until a skewer comes out clean.
